This is the case in VTES. In Jyhad, one merely had to have the ability to
deal Ranged damage, and one could target retainers even at close range.

: Let's say I have two resplendent protectors on Elliot Sinclair, and

: is targeting the retainers. Does he:

: 0) Target one retainer, blast its one life into scrap, and the other

Got it on the first try.

You target a specific retainer, and attempt to kill it. Overkill is
wasted and affects neither the vampire nor any other retainers.

Messages.Author: Chick Lewis
Messages.Body:
I have a little confusion about how damaging retainers works. I
understand that you can only target retainers from long range.

Let's say I have two resplendent protectors on Elliot Sinclair, and

my predator takes a shotgun strike from long range, declaring that he
is targeting the retainers. Does he:

0) Target one retainer, blast its one life into scrap, and the other
two damage from the shotgun are wasted, or

1) Same as 0) above but the remaining two damage go into Elliot, with
the surviving resplendent protector preventing one damage, or

2) Target retainers in general, blasting the one life each from both
retainers with the remaining damage from the shotgun wasted, or

3) Same as 2) above but the remaining one damage goes into Elliot, or

4) Same as 3) above but the remaining damage is prevented by the
Resplendent protectors as they die.

???????????

Please advise.

Chick...@msn.com
